scope: Source provenance only; never optimize offsets against glucose outcomes
processed_probe: For each of ten subjects choose the first numeric pickle member in the published archive; no outcome-dependent sampling
range_integrity: Require exact HTTP 206 Content-Range; archive member CRC32 and SHA256; not full-archive MD5 verification
label_audit: All raw EGV records; units, censoring, duplicate/conflicting timestamps, published source Index and naive timestamp
clock_boundary: Agreement with author processed timestamps supports preprocessing consistency, not independent physical clock calibration. Retain previously sensor-validated E4 shifts and quarantine. No automatic clock correction.
